annotations.title: Get SaSame's ed25519 public key (offline verify)

description: Return SaSame's ed25519 PUBLIC key. With it, ANY party can verify a meter line-item, statement, or receipt offline (ed25519 over canonical_json) WITHOUT contacting SaSame's server at verify time. Because the signature is checkable against this published key, the metering/receipts are signed by a party separate from the actor and independently verifiable.
name: trust_pubkey
